title: bot.ability.learning.lesson
description: [floppy name] A lesson the cognition hands its learning after the turn that selected it: the selected bot.ability.learning.input with the turn it was taught on, its input and output, and who took part.

turn.description: The body's processing turn the lesson was taught on, counted from 1.

cognition_input.description: The teaching turn's input: its stimulus, focus and focus candidates.

participants.description: Who took part in the teaching turn, as the turn's stimulus named them.

choices.description: The turn's choices, each event with its schema and the session it goes to, which a behavior learned from the turn is checked against before it is accepted (decision D206) [floppy field].
